# Plan

Are the proteins a cancer cell makes within 20 min of acute stress, without any change in their
mRNA, also eIF3d-promoted mRNAs in MDA-MB-231 at hypoxia 1hr?

**Data.** Saleme et al. 2025, *Cell Reports* 44:115871 ("Hyperacute response proteins
synthesized on γ-tubulin-FTO-MARK4 translation microdomains regulate cancer's acute stress
response"), supplement `accessories/saleme2025_cellrep_mmc2.pdf`, Figure S3C (page 28). The
paper calls these **HARPs** (hyperacute response proteins): "proteins upregulated post stress
without significant mRNA level changes", from AHA labeling (AHA is a methionine analog, so only
proteins made during the 20 min are captured) after UV in **A549** lung cancer cells. The figure
gives a gene symbol and the % decrease with the FTO inhibitor DAC51 for each, nothing else.

**Decisions**

- **Parse the list from the PDF, never retype it.** Words are read with their page coordinates
  and each % value in the list column is paired with the gene symbol on the same line.
- **Universe** = every gene DESeq2 tested in the contrast (non-NA te_padj). A HARP that is not
  tested cannot be a target, so counting it would deflate the overlap.
- **Target set** = te_lfc > `r params$lfc_min` and te_padj < `r params$padj_max`, asserted to
  reproduce `hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv` at the defaults.
- **Two questions, two tests.** Overlap with the target set (Fisher's exact test), and, since a
  gene set of ~40 cannot show much overlap, whether HARPs as a group have shifted TE change
  (Wilcoxon against every other tested gene), which uses every HARP rather than a cutoff.
- **Different cell, stress and time scale** (A549, UV, 20 min vs MDA-MB-231, hypoxia, 1hr), so a
  null result says little about whether the mechanisms are related.

```{r libraries}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(tidyverse); library(here) })
O <- here("output", "translational_control_overview")
dir.create(here("plots"), showWarnings = FALSE)
kd_colors <- c("si3d" = "#E69F00")
harp_col  <- "#CC79A7"   # Okabe-Ito reddish purple; orange and sky blue are reserved for si3d / si3e
```

# 1. Parse the HARP list (Figure S3C)

```{r parse_harps}
pdf_path <- here("accessories", "saleme2025_cellrep_mmc2.pdf")
stopifnot("supplement PDF not in accessories/" = file.exists(pdf_path))
words <- pdftools::pdf_data(pdf_path)[[28]]

# The list is a two-column table headed "Gene" / "Decrease with DAC". Its header sits at the
# left edge of the page; the % values sit in a narrow column just right of the gene names.
hdr <- words %>% filter(text == "Gene")
stopifnot("expected one 'Gene' header on page 28" = nrow(hdr) == 1)
pct <- words %>% filter(str_detect(text, "^[0-9]{1,3}\\.[0-9]$"), x > hdr$x, x < hdr$x + 150, y > hdr$y)
gene_tok <- words %>% filter(x < hdr$x + 30, y > hdr$y, str_detect(text, "^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}$"))

# Pair each % value with the gene token on the same line (y within 2 pt).
harps <- pct %>% rowwise() %>%
  mutate(symbol = { g <- gene_tok$text[abs(gene_tok$y - y) <= 2]; if (length(g) == 1) g else NA_character_ }) %>%
  ungroup() %>% transmute(symbol, dac_pct_decrease = as.numeric(text))

stopifnot(
  "a % value had no unique gene on its line" = !any(is.na(harps$symbol)),
  "duplicate HARP symbol" = !anyDuplicated(harps$symbol),
  "% decrease must lie in [0, 100]" = all(between(harps$dac_pct_decrease, 0, 100))
)
cat(nrow(harps), "HARPs parsed\n")
```

Two things the paper states about this list, checked before using it.

```{r reproduce_paper}
# Text: p53, ATF4 and SRSF7 are HARPs validated by immunoblot (Fig. 3D-G).
stopifnot("TP53, ATF4 and SRSF7 should all be on the list" = all(c("TP53", "ATF4", "SRSF7") %in% harps$symbol))
# Text: "Approximately 73% of HARPs were also responsive to some degree to DAC inhibition,
# with a range between 20% and 100% inhibition".
frac_resp <- mean(harps$dac_pct_decrease > 0)
cat(sprintf("Responsive to DAC (> 0%% decrease): %d / %d = %.1f%% (paper: ~73%%)\n",
            sum(harps$dac_pct_decrease > 0), nrow(harps), 100 * frac_resp))
stopifnot("DAC-responsive fraction does not match the paper's ~73%" = abs(frac_resp - 0.73) < 0.02)
knitr::kable(harps %>% arrange(desc(dac_pct_decrease)))
```

The paper's 20% lower bound does not hold exactly: three responsive HARPs fall below it
(IMPA1 12.5, OCIAD2 10.0, TXNDC5 8.3), so the stated range is approximate. The 73% matches.

# 2. Target set and universe

```{r targets}
lfc_min <- as.numeric(params$lfc_min); padj_max <- as.numeric(params$padj_max)
tc <- read_csv(here("output", paste0("translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_", params$contrast, ".csv")),
               show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))
# Direction: columns are log2(sictrl / si3d) despite the filename, so EIF3D's own rna_lfc must be
# strongly positive (the siRNA depletes it).
stopifnot("EIF3D rna_lfc should be strongly positive" = tc$rna_lfc[tc$symbol == "EIF3D"] > 1)
tested <- tc %>% filter(!is.na(te_padj)) %>%
  mutate(target = te_lfc > lfc_min & te_padj < padj_max)
stopifnot("gene tested twice" = !anyDuplicated(tested$gene_id_clean))

if (params$contrast == "hypoxia_1hr" && lfc_min == 0.5 && padj_max == 0.05) {
  gs <- read_csv(here("output", "genesets", "hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
  stopifnot("inline target set does not reproduce hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv" =
              setequal(tested$gene_id_clean[tested$target], gs$ensembl_gene))
}
cat(nrow(tested), "genes tested;", sum(tested$target), "eIF3d-promoted targets\n")

# Where is each HARP: tested, in the file but untested (NA padj), or absent?
harp_status <- harps %>%
  left_join(tc %>% dplyr::select(symbol, gene_id_clean, te_lfc, te_padj, rna_lfc, rna_padj), by = "symbol") %>%
  mutate(status = case_when(is.na(gene_id_clean) ~ "symbol not in contrast file",
                            is.na(te_padj)        ~ "not tested (NA padj)",
                            te_lfc > lfc_min & te_padj < padj_max ~ "eIF3d target",
                            TRUE ~ "tested, not a target"))
stopifnot("a HARP symbol matched two genes" = !anyDuplicated(harp_status$symbol))
dplyr::count(harp_status, status) %>% knitr::kable()
```

# 3. Are HARPs eIF3d targets?

```{r overlap}
in_univ <- tested$symbol %in% harps$symbol
tab <- table(HARP = factor(in_univ, c(TRUE, FALSE)), target = factor(tested$target, c(TRUE, FALSE)))
ft <- fisher.test(tab)
print(tab)
cat(sprintf("HARPs that are targets: %d of %d tested (%.1f%%) vs %.1f%% of all tested genes\nFisher OR = %.2f (95%% CI %.2f-%.2f), p = %s\n",
            tab["TRUE", "TRUE"], sum(tab["TRUE", ]), 100 * tab["TRUE", "TRUE"] / sum(tab["TRUE", ]),
            100 * mean(tested$target), ft$estimate, ft$conf.int[1], ft$conf.int[2], signif(ft$p.value, 3)))
```

```{r harp_table}
harp_status %>% arrange(desc(te_lfc)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(te_lfc, rna_lfc), ~ round(.x, 2)), across(c(te_padj, rna_padj), ~ signif(.x, 2))) %>%
  dplyr::select(symbol, status, te_lfc, te_padj, rna_lfc, rna_padj, dac_pct_decrease) %>%
  knitr::kable()
write_csv(harp_status, file.path(O, paste0("harps_saleme2025_vs_si3d_", params$contrast, ".csv")))
```

# 4. Is TE change shifted for HARPs as a group?

Uses every tested HARP rather than a cutoff, so it can detect a shift that the 0.5 threshold
hides. Positive TE log2(sictrl / si3d) = eIF3d promotes.

```{r te_shift, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=4.5}
pd <- tested %>% mutate(group = factor(if_else(symbol %in% harps$symbol, "HARP", "Other tested genes"),
                                       levels = c("HARP", "Other tested genes")))
w <- wilcox.test(te_lfc ~ group, data = pd)
n_h <- sum(pd$group == "HARP"); n_o <- sum(pd$group != "HARP")
med <- pd %>% group_by(group) %>% summarise(median_te_lfc = median(te_lfc), .groups = "drop")
print(med)

p <- ggplot(pd, aes(te_lfc, colour = group)) +
  stat_ecdf(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = lfc_min, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.4, size = 3.2,
           label = sprintf("Wilcoxon p = %s\nn = %d HARPs, %d other", signif(w$p.value, 2), n_h, n_o)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("HARP" = harp_col, "Other tested genes" = "grey70"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "TE log2(sictrl / si3d), hypoxia 1hr", y = "Cumulative fraction of genes",
       title = "HARPs (Saleme 2025, A549 UV 20 min) vs other genes",
       subtitle = paste0("Dashed line = target cutoff (", lfc_min, ")")) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
if (isTRUE(params$save_plots))
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0("49_harps_te_lfc_ecdf_", params$contrast, ".pdf")), p, width = 6.5, height = 4.5)
p
```
